00386
⌈If Eth_ImmediateTransmit has been called, EthCtrlEnableEgressHard-
wareSupportedDataTransfer is set to TRUE and all data transfer sessions have
confirmed successful transfer for a specific EthCtrlConfigEgressQueue element,
then the Ethernet driver shall perform the following actions:
• remove all data transfer session handles which are associated with this EthC-
trlConfigEgressQueue element
• trigger a transmission of the content of this EthCtrlConfigEgressQueue ele-
ment
⌋
Please note: Mapping of EthCtrlConfigEgressQueue element and the given Ctr-
lIdx to TxHandleId is needed for asynchronous check in the EthIf_MainFunc-
tionTx or within an interrupt.
